channel.title: Writing — Marco Strote
channel.description: Articles by Marco Strote on the EU AI Act, AI governance, risk classification and the practice of AI compliance.

item.title: The AI Inventory — The Least Glamorous First Step
item.description: No inventory, no risk classification. No classification, no compliance. A practical guide to building a defensible AI inventory — and where it usually falls apart.

item.title: Agentic AI and Article 14 — The Unresolved Conflict
item.description: The EU AI Act requires human oversight of AI decisions. Autonomous agents decide at machine speed. What companies need to ensure regardless.

item.title: Deployers, Not Just Providers — Who the EU AI Act Actually Affects
item.description: Most companies think the EU AI Act only concerns those who build AI. If you use someone else's AI, you're a deployer — with obligations. Since February 2025.
